selector.rationale: The presence of hyperkeratotic plaques, bullae, and erythema, along with genetic testing revealing a heterozygous variation in KRT1, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis
rejected.why: While it shares some features, the broader range of skin manifestations and specific genetic variation point more strongly to Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma.
